status: Source-only staged competence protocol; no 19-case future metric or held-v8 artifact is authorized.
motivation: NeuSpring reports that continuously optimized canonical tri-plane spring properties and per-object five-region topology act synergistically. Earlier Bayesian-PhysTwin experiments tested low-rank RBF fields and small static topology banks, not this interaction.
claim_boundary: This is an independent implementation of a paper-described mechanism, not an official NeuSpring reproduction. The official NeuSpring repository at commit 51d94f67ed1e2557fca29c1e86b418506e3d51ca contains no implementation or checkpoint.

evidence_boundary.selection_interval: remaining 25 percent of the released observation prefix
evidence_boundary.future_metrics: forbidden until every source gate passes
evidence_boundary.held_v8: all runtime, target, query, score, barrier, and outcome artifacts forbidden

stage_0_identity.zero_coefficients: must reproduce the same-run exact-teacher trajectory bit for bit
stage_0_identity.future_mutation: mutating observations after train_end_frame must not change fitted parameters or prefix selection
stage_0_identity.controller_separation: controller springs use one parameter outside the object tri-planes
stage_0_identity.gradient_check: one finite-difference direction must agree in sign with the Warp gradient

stage_1_field_competence.coordinate_frame: deterministic right-handed PCA frame over canonical object-spring midpoints
stage_1_field_competence.representation: three scalar XY/YZ/XZ planes with bilinear interpolation; the three queried values are averaged
stage_1_field_competence.resolution: round(0.85 * sqrt(number of object springs)), minimum 2
stage_1_field_competence.loss: existing hard observation loss; state innovation is used once
stage_1_field_competence.checkpoint_selection: balanced official CD/track ratio on the permitted prefix suffix

stage_2_piecewise_topology.region_assignment: deterministic agglomerative clustering in the same canonical frame
stage_2_piecewise_topology.candidate_generation: deterministic Latin hypercube fixed before source suffix scoring
stage_2_piecewise_topology.homogeneous_initialization: fit object and controller log scales on the inner prefix before topology selection
stage_2_piecewise_topology.topology_selection: balanced official CD/track ratio on an inner prefix suffix
stage_2_piecewise_topology.field_fit: fit the unchanged stage_1 tri-plane field on the selected topology
stage_2_piecewise_topology.fallback: exact released topology and exact teacher spring field

source_gate.authorized_only_if: stage_1 development gate and all stage_0 checks pass
source_gate.failure: close this mechanism family without a 19-case future run

forbidden: changing field resolution, learning rate, smoothness, topology bank, split, or gates after seeing a permitted suffix
using the released future for fitting, checkpoint selection, fallback, or covariance calibration
calling this implementation NeuSpring without the qualifier paper-described or independent
using all-frame MatPhys, MotionCrafter, Prob4D, VGGT, or manual future identities
opening or deriving any held-v8 identity or outcome
